name: goldilocks
description: Right-sized subagents and continuous PR monitoring in one Codex plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Right-size subagents and monitor PR CI, comments, and reviews
interface.longDescription: Preserves existing workflows while routing already-planned subagents, and delegates PR monitoring, evidence delivery, and watcher lifecycle registration through one Go CLI downloaded on first use.
